name: Galerio – Elementor Photo and Video Gallery
author: MhrTheme

sections.description:
Galerio is a photo and video gallery plugin for elementor addons. There are multiple types of layouts and designs. We provided various styles of widgets in multiple fields. All of the designs are fully mobile responsive, very easy to use, & customizable. You will like all of the designs in our plugin.

Live Demo: Check here

Buy Pro Version: Check here

Photo Gallery Features:

Thumbnail Grid Layout: A clean, responsive grid displaying multiple image thumbnails.

Lightbox Popups: Click any thumbnail to open a larger version in a modal or lightbox view.

Responsive Design: Automatically adapts to various screen sizes (desktop, tablet, mobile).

Configurable Transitions: Smooth transitions (e.g., crossfade, expand) when navigating images.

Video Gallery Features:

Video Embedding Support: Easily embed YouTube, Vimeo, or self-hosted videos using simple embed codes or custom HTML elements.

Responsive Design: Video player automatically adjusts to the screen size, ensuring compatibility across desktops, tablets, and mobile devices.

Custom Play Button: Customizable play button and overlay graphics to match the page’s style.

Full-Screen Mode: Users can expand the video to full-screen mode for an immersive viewing experience.

Use of Plugin:

  1. Navigate to the page or post you wish to edit and click “Edit with Elementor.”
  2. On the left side of the Elementor Editor, you will find the widgets panel, which contains PhotoGallery and VideoGallery elements (widgets) you can add to your page.
  3. Browse through these specific widgets, or use the search bar by searching Photo Gallery or Video Gallery.
  4. Click and hold the desired widget from the panel and drag it onto the page canvas where you want to place it. A blue line will indicate where the element will be inserted.
  5. Alternatively, you can click on the desired location on the canvas where you want to add the element. Then, click the element in the widgets panel. Elementor will automatically place the element at the selected location, depending on whether you are using containers or sections.
  6. Once the element is on the canvas, you can click on it to access its settings in the left panel. Here, you can customize its content, style, and advanced settings.

External Services:

This plugin is connected with magnific popup for creating multiple types of galleries.

The magnific popup is primarily used to create responsive, fast, and mobile-friendly lightbox and modal dialogs on websites. It allows users to display various content types, including images, inline HTML, AJAX content, iframes (such as videos or maps), and image galleries, in a modal window or pop-up.

This service is available under the MIT license and will always remain this way.
http://dimsemenov.com/plugins/magnific-popup/
sections.installation:
From the dashboard:

  1. Go to the WordPress Dashboard “Add New Plugin” section
  2. Search For “Galerio”
  3. Install, then Activate it

From the control panel:

  1. Unzip (if it is zipped) and Upload galerio folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
sections.faq:
Can I use the plugin without Elementor Website Builder?

No. You cannot use without Elementor since it’s an addon for Elementor.

Does it work with any theme?

Absolutely! It will work with any theme where Elementor works.
